spec.title: Terminal Session Setup — the lane Frame opens is a lane Frame set up

tasks.title: Add pure src/main/shellSetup.js — the delivery table for terminal session setup
tasks.whatChanged: New pure module src/main/shellSetup.js: shellFamily() maps a shell path to posix/fish/none, shellInitPath() spells the .frame/runtime/shell/ layout once, mintMarker() mints a per-terminal per-attempt token, deliveryFor() returns the fish -C args / the typed POSIX line / none behind the win32, no-project and not-a-Frame-project gates, and splitOnMarker() says what part of a buffered chunk survives the marker. test/shellSetup.test.js covers all of it.
tasks.whyChanged: The marker is emitted as two adjacent single-quoted fragments so the literal token never appears in the line the tty echoes back — otherwise a scan of the output would match the echo and report setup installed before the shell had run anything. Markers are minted per attempt for the same reason in reverse: a retry reusing the first token would be resolved by output still in flight.
